paths.name: axios
paths.message: Raw axios default import bypasses request-filtering-agent's SSRF protection (private/loopback/link-local/cloud-metadata IPs). Use safeHttp.axios / safeHttp.createAxios({ ... }) from @aiqadam/server-utils instead. See .claude/rules/safe-http.md.

paths.name: @aiqadam/qadams-common
paths.message: @aiqadam/qadams-common's httpClient is a bare `new AxiosHttpClient()` with no request-filtering-agent, so importing it here bypasses SSRF protection exactly as `axios.create(...)` would — the rule is about the outbound request, not about which package constructed the client. It also sets NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED=0 process-wide. Use safeHttp.axios / safeHttp.createAxios({ ... }) from @aiqadam/server-utils instead. See .claude/rules/safe-http.md.

no-restricted-syntax.message: Raw fetch(...) bypasses request-filtering-agent's SSRF protection. Use safeHttp.axios / safeHttp.createAxios({ ... }) from @aiqadam/server-utils instead. See .claude/rules/safe-http.md.
Raw globalThis.fetch(...) bypasses request-filtering-agent's SSRF protection. Use safeHttp.axios / safeHttp.createAxios({ ... }) from @aiqadam/server-utils instead. See .claude/rules/safe-http.md.

Raw <obj>.fetch(...) (e.g. window.fetch) bypasses request-filtering-agent's SSRF protection. Use safeHttp.axios / safeHttp.createAxios({ ... }) from @aiqadam/server-utils instead. See .claude/rules/safe-http.md.
axios.create(...) bypasses request-filtering-agent's SSRF protection. Use safeHttp.createAxios({ ... }) from @aiqadam/server-utils instead. See .claude/rules/safe-http.md.
Calling axios(...) directly bypasses request-filtering-agent's SSRF protection. Use safeHttp.axios from @aiqadam/server-utils instead. See .claude/rules/safe-http.md.

Importing an already-constructed HTTP client bypasses request-filtering-agent's SSRF protection just as raw axios does, and the no-restricted-imports path entry above only sees the bare '@aiqadam/qadams-common' specifier — this catches any module path, including a deep import or a local re-export. Use safeHttp.axios / safeHttp.createAxios({ ... }) from @aiqadam/server-utils instead. See .claude/rules/safe-http.md.

Reaching an unfiltered HTTP client through a namespace import or require() bypasses request-filtering-agent's SSRF protection. Use safeHttp.axios / safeHttp.createAxios({ ... }) from @aiqadam/server-utils instead. See .claude/rules/safe-http.md.
